comment: Blind round r1: the three ep01 repack pairs, each placed in a mobile Suggested (Up next) list with 7 ep01 hosts and in a mobile Home feed with 3 hosts. Same host SET per surface for every candidate (like-for-like); host order and our slot are shuffled per feed (distinct slots across candidates on a surface). File numbers are shuffled too, so neither the name nor the order reveals the candidate or its slot.

surfaces.name: mobile_suggested
surfaces.desc: Mobile watch page, full scroll: pinned player (now playing), video info, then the Up next compact list (168x94 thumbs, title up to 3 lines) with 7 hosts + ours.

surfaces.name: mobile_home
surfaces.desc: Mobile Home feed, full scroll: header + chips, then full-width 390x219 cards (title up to 2 lines, one meta line) with 3 hosts + ours, bottom nav.

candidates.title: Why the Continents Point South (It's a Breakup)
South America Points at Antarctica. So Does Africa
The Continents Look Like They're Dripping South

note: Written to feeds/ep01_r1/ instead of feeds/ because a concurrent ep02 blind round (feedsim/blind/blind_r1.py, 12 Hawaii pairs) writes and deletes feeds/r1_*.png and feeds/r1_key.json at the same time; the subfolder keeps both rounds intact.
